story_overview: At Trattoria Milano, Victor and Nico finish a meal as their waitress, Isla, clears the table. Victor and his associate Leo then make a tense phone call. Elsewhere, Marco talks with Silas on a terrace, and strange objects like a cracked doll's head and an old photograph hint at a deeper mystery.

video_prompts:
Nico: Woman with long dark hair, wearing a tan shirt.
Victor: Bald man with a dark mustache, wearing a white button-up shirt and a diagonally striped tie.
Trattoria Milano: Restaurant interior with a dining table

In Trattoria Milano, Victor and Nico sit at the polished wood table. Victor puts on the black sunglasses, then wipes his mouth with the creased paper napkin. A waitress approaches their table and begins clearing away the stack of dirty plates. The pint of beer and the pack of Astor cigarettes sit on the table.

the unlit cigarette: Slender, white paper-wrapped cylinder of tobacco with a tan-colored, cork-patterned filter tip.
the wall-mounted rotary phone: Glossy black Bakelite wall-mounted rotary phone with a circular dial, metal finger stop, and a classic handset attached by a coiled cord.
the vintage Fernet-Branca poster: Large, vintage-style Italian advertising poster with a dark green design, an illustration of a brown eagle with spread wings and talons on a globe, stylized white and red text for FERNET-BRANCA, and the text Fratelli Branca - Milano.
Medium shot in Trattoria Milano. Victor, wearing the black sunglasses, stands up from the polished wood table with the unlit cigarette in his mouth. He walks across the room toward the wall-mounted rotary phone, which hangs next to the vintage Fernet-Branca poster.

Leo: An unlit cigarette hangs from his mouth.

Leo stands next to the wall-mounted rotary phone and dials a number. The unlit cigarette hangs from his mouth as he dials. Victor, wearing the black sunglasses, stands close by, watching him. The vintage Fernet-Branca poster is on the wall beside them.

Medium close-up of Victor inside Trattoria Milano. He is talking on the wall-mounted rotary phone, with the unlit cigarette dangling from his mouth. He is wearing the white collared shirt and the black sunglasses.
Victor, wearing the black sunglasses, holds the handset of the wall-mounted rotary phone to his ear and speaks into it.
